Product Profile
CR Dhan 210 is an aerobic variety developed by NRRI, Cuttack, specifically recommended for areas suitable for water limited environments. Released in 2020, it boasts an average yield of 4.75 tons per hectare. Moderately resistant to a range of diseases and pests including leaf blast, neck blast, brown spot, sheath rot, stem borer (both dead heart and white ear heads), leaf folder, and green leaf hopper, CR Dhan 210 offers robust protection against common threats. Featuring long slender grains, it is particularly recommended for favorable upland conditions in Odisha.
